title: Signal Bar & Pivot Lenses: Console IA for fast workspace pivots and cost telemetry
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: Current console navigation bundles workspace switching, model selection, and route-level dashboards into a single vertical left rail. Teams report cognitive overhead when switching contexts for cost troubleshooting or for launching a rollout. This ticket proposes a complementary lateral 'Signal Bar' — a slim, context-aware strip that surfaces active signals (rollouts, cost anomalies, incidents) and fast pivots into workspace 'lenses' (compact, task-focused views). Goal: reduce time-to-action for common tasks (see acceptance criteria).

Scope: IA exploration, low-fidelity prototypes, accessibility pass, and a design review with PM/Eng. Not in scope: backend telemetry plumbing (will be surfaced via links to existing metrics endpoints) or final visual polish for theming — those are follow-ups after UX approval.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates a single-click pivot from any route to three primary lenses: Cost Overview, Rollout Controls, and Recent Incidents
Information architecture documentation (sitemap + annotated flows) approved by PM and Engineering
Prototype includes at least two error/edge states (no telemetry & service unavailable) and clear affordances
Accessibility checklist passed for keyboard navigation and screen reader announcements for the Signal Bar
Engineering viability notes captured with suggested payloads and two fallback patterns for environments without telemetry
decisions: Signal Bar will be a separate lateral layer, persistent on wide layouts and collapsible into an affordance on narrow/compact screens
Three canonical lenses chosen for initial rollout: Cost Overview (token/cost breakdowns), Rollout Controls (canary/A-B toggles + health), and Recent Incidents (paged list + quick links)
Signal Bar items will show a micro-badge with severity/priority and can be muted per workspace
Primary pivot action opens a lightweight panel (lens) carved out from current console canvas; deep links preserve context and are shareable
open_questions: What level of telemetry aggregation should appear in the Cost Overview lens by default (last 1h vs 24h)? Need PM/Research decision
How should Signal Bar permissions respect Dedicated/Private role scoping? (RBAC constraints may hide rollout controls)
Are we comfortable with the extra persistent render cost for the Signal Bar in low-powered private installs? Engineering to propose an opt-out flag
Should lenses be first-class in the routing model (own route IDs) or ephemeral overlays? This affects back-button behavior and deep linking
